title: Entity Healthbar
description: Adds stylized healthbars on hit of any entity with Health.
body:
This datapack currently gives you 96 different combinations of options to set the text display that spawns when something gets damaged. You choose from 6 styles, 8 colors, and wether you want it to be bold or not. Minecraft version 1.21.6 and up lets you use a dialog to configure each option for quick and easy use! P.S. you will need cheats enabled to configure the bar, but do not always need cheats to see them.


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/t3OJdh87qIk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


**Set Up:**

No set up required, works out of the box displaying non bolden red hearts when something takes damage above their head.

**Config:**

Dialog menu accessible on Minecraft **version 1.21.6 and up** with this command:
/dialog show @s entityhealthbar:healthbar_config_style

![menu 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edee2fb556526e956cbd22c6868bae6b337d85fc_0.webp)

![menu 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12a6401813174cbe50ca40b28673fc66d4f1aa38_0.webp)

_Requires OP or cheats enabled on local world._

Function commands accessible on **all Minecraft versions:**

❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤

/function entityhealthbar:style1

▉▉▉▉▉▉▉▉▉▉

/function entityhealthbar:style2

⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫⚫

/function entityhealthbar:style3

♦♦♦♦♦♦♦♦♦♦

/function entityhealthbar:style4

♣♣♣♣♣♣♣♣♣♣

/function entityhealthbar:style5

♠♠♠♠♠♠♠♠♠♠

/function entityhealthbar:style6

/function entityhealthbar:bold

/function entityhealthbar:notbold

/function entityhealthbar:color<1-8>
See image above for which number corresponds to which color.

All functions equire OP or cheats enabled on local world.
